propositions: fsck's JSON output computes issue_count as len(issues) over all emitted KIND lines, while the exit code respects each finding's is_issue flag, causing disagreement when never-counted kinds are present
Never-counted finding kinds (push_pending, status_fork_resolved, tracker_dirty_tmp_event, warn) inflate the JSON issue_count but contribute nothing to the exit code
An uninitialized store renders in JSON output byte-identically to a clean store (empty issues[], issue_count=0, exit=1) making the two indistinguishable to JSON consumers
The fix redefines issue_count as the counted subset (respecting is_issue) across CLI, library, and MCP surfaces, adding an additive counted boolean per issue while keeping issues[] complete
Never-counted kinds must be drift-proofed: tracker-dirty kinds derived from _DIRTY_LINE_SPECS (lowercased), and three inline scan/health kinds made explicit with pointer comments at production sites
